title: Sales Engineer
text:
About Druva
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

Position Summary:

Druva is seeking to hire a Sales Engineering Specialist with a focus on Endpoint Data Protection and Data Security. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide technical direction and business guidance to the regional sales teams. We are looking for a motivated and proactive individual to help exceed sales targets by driving innovative technical programs, conducting customer demonstrations, POCs, and overseeing daily technical solutioning activities. You will be responsible for evangelizing, positioning, and architecting Druva’s Endpoint Data Protection & Data Security Solutions to a mix of new & existing customer accounts in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

Demonstrates technical leadership and subject matter expertise on fully managed cloud-native SaaS, Endpoint Data Protection & Data Security, and Cyber Resiliency

Provides technical leadership and direction to customers and internal staff in the development of Druva solutions, supporting pre-sales activities within the assigned region

Leverage technical discovery and qualification fundamentals to establish rapport as a trusted advisor to develop and propose solutions that meet the technology and business requirements of prospective & existing customer accounts in the region

Meet business objectives by collaborating with Sales Executives in the region

Assist in delivering technical enablement to the Druva Channel Partner ecosystem

Requirements:

6+ years in technical customer-facing roles with at least 2+ years as a sales engineer working with enterprise software solutions

Intermediate-level knowledge of enterprise server backup technologies

Intermediate level knowledge of operating systems, including MS Windows, Linux,& macOS.

Experience with Active Directory, Entra ID,  SSO, MFA, SCCM, and automated deployment tools.

Knowledge and practical experience with virtual desktop infrastructures such as VMware Horizon, Amazon WorkSpaces, Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop, etc.

Basic understanding of network technologies and protocols – TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, switches, firewalls, routers, and proxies

Entrepreneurial - willing to go the extra mile, strong work ethic, resourceful, “get it done” attitude

A highly energetic drive to meet goals with a strong hands-on, “can-do” approach

Strives in moving in a fast-paced environment, including handling multiple calls/demos per day with immediate follow-up.

Desired Skills and Experience:

Experience with a SaaS company or demonstrable knowledge of SaaS practices

Intermediate level of knowledge of cloud-native IaaS & PaaS services.

A high level of business acumen and experience working with various cross-functional stakeholders to foster collaboration in solving business challenges

Fundamental knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity 2.0 framework

Basic knowledge of cybersecurity solutions in the areas of EDR, XDR, MDR, etc.

title: Software Development Engineer II
text:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the team
Service Data Platform, part of Expedia Group’s AI and Data Organization, is a
foundational component of our Service Platform. Our Context Engineering team serves real-time traveler, booking, and trip data across all servicing channels – powering identification and verification, differentiated servicing, contextual routing, and agent tools for the AI and human agents who support our travelers and partners.

Join us to build high-scale data services at the heart of Expedia’s AI-powered servicing experience.

In this role, you will:
• Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance services and
applications, contributing to end-to-end feature delivery across multiple
domains.
• Implement clean, testable code, including system design (low-level design), API
design, and data modeling, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and
maintainable.
• Collaborate with peers, product, and operations teams to translate business and
customer requirements into technical solutions, using data and metrics to guide
decisions.
• Own the full software development lifecycle for your services, including code
reviews, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational support in
production environments.
• Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes,
including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying
AI/ML concepts to real world products.
• Contribute to shared platforms, libraries, and patterns that can be reused across
teams, increasing engineering efficiency and enabling fungibility across multiple
product and service areas.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field; or Equivalent
related professional experience.
• 2+ years of relevant professional experience
• Hands-on experience with object-oriented and functional programming
languages (such as Kotlin, Java, or similar), data structures and algorithms, and
core software engineering practices such as code reviews, unit/integration
testing, CI/CD, and observability.
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement service- or API-based solutions,
including basic data modeling and system design within a single service or small
set of services.
• Experience collaborating in an agile environment, owning features from design
through deployment, and supporting them in production within a team or
product area.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience designing and evolving service architectures, including thoughtful
low-level design, API contracts, and data models that support reliability,
performance, and extensibility.
• Proven experience operating systems at scale, including monitoring, alerting,
incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and cost.
• Track record of using data and experimentation to drive engineering decisions,
optimize user experiences, and improve system behavior.
• Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML
concepts to real world products, including safely integrating AI/ML‑enabled
capabilities into existing services.
• Experience contributing to technical direction within a team through code and
design feedback, and applying modern engineering pract
